They are every user who wrote channel messages, so allowed_dest is empty. The message is a fixed template, not content derived from the user's data, so egress_requested is false. Channel messages must be read across all channels to count them, so the named sources are get_channels and read_channel_messages. send_channel_message is not requested because the messages go to individual users.
